cards.ex: She's only 16, but she's wise beyond her years; she gives great advice.
cards.exUz: U atigi 16 yoshda, lekin u yoshidan dono; u ajoyib maslahatlar beradi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yosh bo'lishiga qaramay, tajribali va aqlli.

cards.ex: My grandfather is 80, but he's still young at heart and loves to dance.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom 80 yoshda, lekin u hali ham qalbi yosh va raqsga tushishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Keksa bo'lishiga qaramay, o'zini yoshdek his qiladigan.

cards.ex: After 20 years in the industry, she's a seasoned professional.
cards.exUz: Sanoatda 20 yildan so'ng, u tajribali mutaxassis.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p yillik tajribaga ega, o'z sohasida yaxshi bilimdon odam.

cards.ex: He was in his prime when he won the championship.
cards.exUz: U chempionatda g'alaba qozonganida eng gullagan davrida edi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotning eng yaxshi, eng kuchli vaqtida bo'lish.

cards.ex: Life experience has taught me to be more patient.
cards.exUz: Hayotiy tajriba menga sabrliroq bo'lishni o'rgatdi.
cards.uzDef: Hayot davomida olingan bilim va ko'nikmalar.

cards.ex: My grandma is getting on in years, but she's still very active.
cards.exUz: Mening buvim yoshga kirmoqda, lekin u hali ham juda faol.
cards.uzDef: Kattaroq yoshga yetib bormoq, qarimoq.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes in a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda ishni o'rganish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ish yoki faoliyatni qanday bajarishni o'rganmoq.

cards.ex: She brings a wealth of experience to the team.
cards.exUz: U jamoaga katta tajriba olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p yillik va keng qamrovli tajriba.

cards.ex: He had to pay his dues before becoming a successful actor.
cards.exUz: U muvaffaqiyatli aktyor bo'lishidan oldin mehnat evaziga erishishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan maqsadga erishish uchun qiyinchiliklarni boshdan kechirmoq.

cards.ex: They're enjoying their golden years traveling the world.
cards.exUz: Ular dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilib, oltin davrlaridan zavqlanishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Pensiaga chiqqandan keyingi hayotning baxtli va farovon davri.

cards.ex: My dad is set in his ways and doesn't like trying new things.
cards.exUz: Mening dadam o'z odatlariga berilib ketgan va yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rishni yoqtirmaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'z odatlaridan voz kechishni xohlamaydigan odam.

cards.ex: He's an old hand at fixing cars.
cards.exUz: U avtomobillarni tuzatishda usta qo'l.
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada katta tajribaga ega bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: The movie is about a young boy's coming of age.
cards.exUz: Film yosh bolaning voyaga yetishi haqida.
cards.uzDef: Bolalikdan kattalikga o'tish jarayoni.

cards.ex: There's often a generation gap between parents and teenagers.
cards.exUz: Ko'pincha ota-onalar va o'smirlar o'rtasida avlodlar farqi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Turli avlodlar orasidagi farqlar, fikrlar to'qnashuvi.

cards.ex: He's a good player, but he's past his prime.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi o'yinchi, lekin u o'zining eng yaxshi davrini o'tkazib bo'lgan.
cards.uzDef: O'zining eng yaxshi davrini o'tkazib bo'lgan.

cards.ex: I wasn't born yesterday; I know what you're trying to do.
cards.exUz: Men kecha tug'ilganim yo'q; sening nima qilmoqchi ekaningni bilaman.
cards.uzDef: Aldanishi oson emas, tajribasiz emas.

cards.ex: She has years of experience in marketing.
cards.exUz: U marketing sohasida yillik tajribaga ega.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida orttirilgan bilim va ko'nikmalar.

cards.ex: I had a senior moment and forgot where I parked my car.
cards.exUz: Menda keksalar holati bo'ldi va mashinamni qayerga qo'yganimni unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Kattalar yoshga xos unutuvchanlik holati.

cards.ex: They say with age comes wisdom, and I think it's true.
cards.exUz: Ular yillar donolik keltiradi deyishadi va menimcha, bu rost.
cards.uzDef: Tajriba ortishi bilan aqlli bo'lib borish.

cards.ex: I'm starting to feel my age; my knees are always aching.
cards.exUz: Men yoshimni his qila boshladim; tizzalarim doimo og'riyapti.
cards.uzDef: Yoshga oid muammolarni sezmoq, o'zini keksa his qilmoq.

cards.ex: Some people think athletes are over the hill after 30.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar sportchilar 30 yoshdan keyin cho'qqidan o'tgan deb o'ylashadi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining eng yaxshi davrini o'tkazib bo'lgan, endi qobiliyati yo'qolgan.

cards.ex: The community center offers activities for golden agers.
cards.exUz: Jamiyat markazi keksa fuqarolar uchun tadbirlar taklif etadi.
cards.uzDef: Katta yoshli odam, pensioner.

cards.ex: He learned everything he knows from the school of hard knocks.
cards.exUz: U o'z bilgan hamma narsani qiyinchilik maktabidan o'rgangan.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklar va tajribalar orqali olingan ta'lim.

cards.ex: I'm not a spring chicken anymore, so I can't run as fast.
cards.exUz: Men endi yosh emasman, shuning uchun tez yugura olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Yosh emas, ancha katta yoshdagi odam.

cards.ex: She's only 10, but she's an old soul.
cards.exUz: U atigi 10 yoshda, lekin u qadimgi ruh.
cards.uzDef: Yosh bo'lishiga qaramay, kattalarga xos donolik va tushunchaga ega bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: Stop being so childish and act your age!
cards.exUz: Bunday bolalarcha bo'lishni bas qiling va yoshingizga mos bo'ling!
cards.uzDef: O'z yoshiga mos ravishda harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Everyone using smartphones is a sign of the times.
cards.exUz: Hamma smartfonlardan foydalanishi - zamonaviylik belgisi.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi zamonning o'ziga xos xususiyati.

cards.ex: In my day, kids played outside more often.
cards.exUz: Bizning zamonda bolalar tashqarida ko'proq o'ynashardi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishda, mening yoshligimda.

cards.ex: Over the years, we've become good friends.
cards.exUz: Yillar davomida biz yaxshi do'st bo'lib qoldik.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida, ko'p yillar mobaynida.

cards.ex: He's a bit long in the tooth to be playing professional sports.
cards.exUz: U professional sport bilan shug'ullanish uchun biroz qarigan.
cards.uzDef: Katta yoshdagi, keksa odam.
